newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics gets contract with Smart.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics gets contract with Smart.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Monday it entered into a multi-million dollar exclusive contract to provide its Total Control Enterprise Network Hub to Smart World Communications.
Specific terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Smart World, an internet-access provider located in Danbury, Conn., is also beta-testing U.S. Robotics' new high-speed x2 modem technology, Robotics said. After field testing in select markets, Smart will offer x2 to all of its subscribers this quarter, U.S. Robotics said.
Smart offers Internet access for free in more than 600 cities.
Smart also signed a contract for U.S. Robotics to provide ongoing support services, the company said.
Smart said it will continue to add equipment to cover additional markets in early 1997, U.S. Robotics said.
